name: Evidence-proposed triage + decision (Gate 0 + Gate 2)
description: Build #3 of the methodology harness. Today the Gate-0 triage state (CockpitControls) and the Gate-2 go/no-go (DecisionControls) are 100% manual operator gut. This build makes the harness PROPOSE both from evidence, with the operator confirming (human-in-the-loop, per the locked engine policy). Composes the pieces already built: the §5 demand scorer (lib/methodology/demand-score.ts — pure, tested), the validation roll-up (lib/methodology/rollup.ts), and the Gate-1 readiness score (#1). The new glue is the BRIDGE from two-stream interview evidence -> the five §5 dimension scores (pain/gap/onsell/reach/build_fit): an LLM judge reads the recorded interview evidence + summaries and emits 0-10 + confidence per dimension (the in-repo classify.ts direct-fetch pattern, NOT the SDK — same call shape as pool-discovery). scoreDemand() then produces GO/REDESIGN/NO-GO with the onsell hard gate; the cockpit renders it as a PROPOSAL the operator confirms or overrides with a logged reason. Hypothesis-mode (desk research) proposal works day one; evidence-mode is only as real as the interview evidence flowing (Build #4 front-leg + a completed voice interview).

env_vars.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env_vars.description: The LLM judge that reads the two-stream interview evidence + summaries and scores the five §5 demand dimensions (0-10 + confidence + rationale) per stream, feeding the pure scoreDemand(). Same key + direct-fetch call shape as pool-discovery (no SDK). Already present on this project.

env_vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
env_vars.description: App public URL — already present; used only if the proposer surfaces links back onto the card.

external_setup.title: No new external setup — composes already-provisioned pieces
external_setup.description: Build #3 reads the validation roll-up + readiness score (existing Supabase tables, already migrated) and calls Anthropic with the existing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (already used by pool-discovery). The new surface is in-repo logic (the evidence->dimensions judge bridge) + a route + the cockpit proposal UI. No new key, dashboard, or package.
steps: Confirm ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is present (it is — pool-discovery uses it): node ~/PycharmProjects/cais-shared-services/scripts/feature-preflight.mjs --feature evidence-decision.

No package install, no dashboard registration. The proposal IS persisted (decided + done at the route-wiring step): migration supabase/migrations/20260527100000_methodology_proposals.sql adds the methodology_proposals snapshot table (RLS on, service-role only, applied via CLI). It uses the existing service-role key — no new env var. The card detail loads the latest snapshot server-side so the LLM pass survives reload + leaves an audit trail; re-scoring is on-demand with stale-marking (THIN_MVP_RUBRIC §6 #7).
